answer: Because the crystal graph is rebuilt each epoch, the meadow merge is applied at settlement and the hollow audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Identities funded from a common source within 39 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
